newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 1996 inflation slows to 21.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Russian 1996 inflation slows to 21.8 percent.

text.p: Russia's monthly inflation rate slowed in December to 1.4 percent, bringing inflation for the whole of 1996 to 21.8 percent, in line with recent government forecasts, the State Statistics Committee said on Monday.
The December year-on-year rate was a post-reform low, as price rises have slowed for most of the year, despite a seasonal upturn in the last few months.
The year-on-year rate in December 1995 was 131 percent.
